body:
Follow-up from the #292 mixed-era placement audit (item 5 of 5). Answers Q5 (which compatibility paths are migration-only, and when they can be removed).

## Context

The identity-placement fallback (the empty-`placement` branch of `ChunkRef::placed_dserver`) exists solely for pre-M3 / mixed-era records. M3+ writes always record a full-length placement vector. So the fallback is **migration-only** and should not stay load-bearing forever.

## Removal path

1. **Backfill migration.** A pass that rewrites every pre-M3 committed chunk map with an explicit identity `placement` (`0..fragment_count()`), using the same version-conditional commit the custodians use (so it races safely with writers/reconstruction). Reconstruction/rebalance already materialize full placement when they touch a chunk; the backfill closes the long tail that is never touched.
2. **Observability.** An empty-placement committed-record counter on the durability-plane seam (ADR-0011) so we can watch the pre-M3 population drain to zero.
3. **Removal gate.** Once the counter reaches zero (and a scan confirms no empty-placement committed records remain), convert the empty-vector branch from silent identity resolution into a **defensive error**, gated behind a format-version bump.

## Notes

Until step 3, keep the fallback. This issue is the tracking item for the migration + the gate; it should be scheduled after the consumers are consistent (the rebalance fix and the `fragments()` helper) and the test matrix is in place.

milestone.description: The self-maintaining durability plane (L4): GC, scrub, reconstruction, rebalance + durability telemetry. Makes single-zone trustworthy; gates the Step-2 release. Plan: proposal 0005.

title: Placement backfill migration + identity-fallback removal gate
